article: RC62 upright-pocket and Beduan four-post socket fit selections
physical_source: Derek tested the completed centered H2C fit samples and selected the labels quoted below.

quotes.magnet_preference: I did some more testing, and changed my mind on the magnet, I think I like C3 better, just a little bit easier to get out of there, which is actually what I want, its still a pretty tight grip, but not so tight that things get risky for loosening the print on the bed during insertion.
quotes.vertical_clearance_intent: Even though I did approve this very tight clearance in X, it is because I actually want us to be gripping in the X axis, and in Z I do not have the same desire, so I anticipate that will be larger, even though it is ostensibly measuring the exact same dimension, what with this magnet being round and all.
quotes.valve_preference: On valves I would like to go with V69, though with a note that V70 might be okay as our alternate to try if we ever find a valve or print orientation that doesn't fit in V69 well.

printed_trial.material: physical black PET-GF, external left slot 254, labeled PET-CF/GFT01

magnet.physical_acceptance_scope: Preferred hand insertion/removal and reported tight grip of the tested RC62 in the open C3 PET-GF coupon. The quote identifies easier extraction and reducing the risk of disturbing the bed-held print during insertion.

production_fit_policy.scope: The X/Y selected fit and Z roof air are independent. The full-width upper mouth permits downward insertion; the lower seat locates the ring and the flat roof provides headroom. The pump cap has no separate retention ring. These dimensions are design policy, not a physical qualification of a closed production pocket.

not_established: Caliper-measured coupon dimensions or magnet dimensions
Universal fit over magnet and printer tolerance
First-layer roof deposition, absence of rattle in a sealed pocket or finished magnetic retention strength

valve.conditional_alternate_rule: Try explicitly selected V70 only when a valve or print orientation does not fit V69 well; no automatic fallback or universal fit claim.
valve.physical_acceptance_scope: The operator selected V69 for the tested valve and enclosure-oriented PET-GF four-post panel. V70 is a conditional alternative to try, not a separately qualified general fit.
valve.earlier_acceptance_scope: The 7.20 mm coupon acceptance covers easy location with zip ties supplying positive retention. It does not qualify the selected tighter sockets.
not_established: Universal fit across all valves or changed print orientations
Insertion/removal force, positive retention load or lifetime
Physical acceptance of every shared seat, tray or cold-core mounting station

scope: Current operator preferences bind printed labels to the exact completed H2C trial. Native hashes establish the sample identity and commanded geometry; the quotations establish the limited physical preferences. Production geometry and future paused prints require their own review and physical result.
